title: Scale By The Bay 2018: Bryan Cantrill, Rust and Other Interesting Things
summary: Bryan Cantrill argues that programming languages and platforms reflect core values, and compares languages through that lens, with Rust as a main example. He draws on his experience with Solaris, DTrace and ZFS.
why: Cited again and again as the framework for discussing languages in terms of values, and how organizational values shape software quality.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Bryan Cantrill has an excellent talk on this
